content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HCL Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL). HCL is a Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, engaged in mining and processing of copper ore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman. This role involves responsibilities related to mine operations and supervision in underground metalliferous mines.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman post in this recruitment drive. Candidates should refer to the official notification for any updates or specific details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is "Walk-in". Eligible candidates need to attend an interview directly at the specified venue on the scheduled date with their documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman post is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates must report on time with all necessary documents for registration and interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman post is 63 years. This age limit is set to ensure candidates have relevant experience while still being able to perform duties effectively.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman post will receive a salary of Rs. 44850 Per Month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Matric/Class 10th Pass with a valid Foreman's Certificate of competency (Un-restricted), a valid First Aid Certificate, and a minimum of 20 years of experience as a Mine Foreman in underground metalliferous mines.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories have a 'Nil' application fee, making it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Manager (Mine)/Mine Foreman post is a "Walk in Interview". Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications, experience, and performance during the interview session.
